_readme: Settings for the Vanilla note skin. A skin only needs one of these if it wants something
other than the defaults; every other skin here ships without one.
rgbStrums says whether the colour shader may recolour this skin's strums. The shader works
by multiplying the sheet's red, green and blue channels by the three colours in the Note
Colors setting, so a skin's strums have to be drawn in those three channels for it to come
out right. This skin's notes and holds are; its press and confirm art is not - it is drawn
in finished colours that no mix of those three reaches, so the shader washed it out. With
this off the strums are drawn as they are.
The notes themselves are unaffected: they are channel art like every other skin, so the
Note Colors setting and the red tint on hurt notes both still work.
